thread:
incident-bot: Pager alert triggered for routing-policy-service: sustained latency spike + 5xxs affecting /v1/generate across multiple regions :rotating_light:

Alex: seeing huge tail-latency for tenant-42. Error rate jumped ~12% last 3m. Any oncall able to take?

Priya: I'm on. digging into routing-policy logs now. initial look: a fallback policy churned — a hosted->dedicated fallback started sending traffic to a dedicated pool that doesn't support the model-variant requested. responses are failing and timing out.

Ben: confirming: dedicated pool accepted requests but returned 502/timeout. KV cache mismatch in variant path.

Alex: @Priya @Ben who owns the policy config? @Maya do we have a recent rollout?

Maya: product pushed a policy tweak earlier in the day to broaden fallback for capacity smoothing. It went through canary and was rolled ~2h ago. I didn't see errors in canary. will pull the config.

Priya: grabbing policy history... 

```
# command
rg "fallback_enabled" --context 2 /opt/configs/routing/* | tail -n 20
```

Priya: policy shows `fallback_variant_preference: [quantized-small, full-32]` but dedicated pool only has `full-32` and a different tokenizer path. mismatch causes model init to fail. There's a retry/backoff loop in router that cycles between region fallback and variant fallback which is amplifying requests — creates a cascading surge.

Alex: this explains tenant isolation bleed — some tenant requests are being reflected into a non-isolated dedicated pool. we need to stop the loop.

Ben: immediate mitigation: disable policy-based fallback for routing-policy-service globally or patch to short-circuit on variant mismatch. I can flip a feature flag.

Priya: agree. flipping feature flag now: `swarmflag routing.fallback.enabled=false`

deploy-bot: Feature flag `routing.fallback.enabled` set to FALSE by Ben at 2024-11-02T15:02:11Z.

Priya: flag flip acknowledged — monitoring shows latency dropping in region-eu-1 and us-west-2. error rate declining from 12% -> 3% in 2 minutes.

Luis: support: Customer ABC (tenant-42) on support channel reporting intermittent 5xxs and slow responses since ~14:45 UTC. I'm updating them: we have mitigation in progress and will follow up.

Maya: can we identify all affected tenants quickly? need a scoped list for communications.

Priya: querying request-routing logs for misrouted pool id `dedicated-pool-17`

```
# quick log query
es query: index=routing-logs pool_id:dedicated-pool-17 AND status:5xx AND ts:[1719000000 TO 1719002000]
```

Priya: initial set: tenant-42, tenant-77, tenant-210. volume mainly from tenant-42.

Alex: Ben — can you drain `dedicated-pool-17` and remap its traffic to alternate dedicated pools that have correct variant metadata? Need graceful drain to avoid more failures.

Ben: starting drain: `swarmctl pool drain dedicated-pool-17 --reason=misvariant-routing`

Ben: drain kicked. redirecting new allocations to `dedicated-pool-19` and `dedicated-pool-20`.

incident-bot: Pool `dedicated-pool-17` marked draining by Ben. Autoscaler will avoid new allocations.

Priya: after drain and flag flip, we're seeing 200s restore across regions, latency stabilized. No evidence of token leakage but there was a short period where requests bypassed tenant isolation checks due to a rule precedence bug in the policy evaluator.

Raj: need to block until we patch evaluator precedence — I propose rollback of the policy delta that expanded fallback rules, then run staged re-deploy with stricter unit tests for variant compatibility.

Maya: agreed. I'll open rollback PR and coordinate canary validation with @Priya.

Luis: I'll send affected-customer notice: brief outage window, root cause (routing fallback misconfiguration + variant mismatch), mitigation (flag flip + pool drain), and ETA for postmortem.

Priya: capture timeline for postmortem:
- 14:45 UTC: policy rollout increased fallback surface
- 14:52 UTC: first errors observed, incident-bot paged
- 14:58 UTC: flag disable started
- 15:02 UTC: pool drain started
- 15:08 UTC: error rate down to baseline

Alex: good. any lingering risk? autoscales could reassign to drained pool later if flag re-enabled. put a temporary pool-blacklist and add preflight variant check in router.

Ben: implemented temporary pool-blacklist: `swarmctl pool annotate dedicated-pool-17 blacklist=true` and added preflight check patch to staging.

deploy-bot: Patch `router:preflight-variant-check` deployed to staging at 2024-11-02T15:18:40Z by Ben.

Priya: for postmortem we should include: policy testing gaps, canary coverage blindspots (didn't detect variant metadata mismatch), router retry/backoff behavior creating amplification, and tenant isolation risk. Also propose adding a lightweight metadata compatibility check in canary pipeline.

Maya: noted. I'll schedule follow-up with product + eng + SRE for tomorrow.

Luis: customer update sent to tenant-42 and tenant-77. they're asking for incident report. I'll loop in CS.

Alex: thanks all. closing pager for now once monitoring holds for 30m. leaving incident channel open for notes. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident acknowledged. Monitoring threshold restored at 15:38 UTC. Please file postmortem under /incidents/ with root cause and action items.

Priya: filing collected logs and config diffs to the incident repo. will draft RCA.

Ben: I'll follow up with infra runbook updates to include pool variant-metadata checks on allocation.

Maya: extra ask: add a pre-merge CI job that validates policy deltas against a compatibility matrix to prevent similar rollouts.

Raj: assigning action owners in the follow-up doc.

Alex: thanks team. stand down unless something pops back up.
